page_title: HEI 3-3 STU | Heidenheim v Stuttgart 22/02/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's the end of the match.
90+4' Eren Dinkci (Heidenheim) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
90+2' Chema Andres (VfB Stuttgart) gets a yellow card for protesting.
90+2' Bilal El Khannouss (VfB Stuttgart) gets a yellow card, off the field.
90+2' What an amazing save by Diant Ramaj! Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) swirls around the defenders and attempts to beat the keeper with a close-range shot towards the bottom left corner, but fails.
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
88' 3 - 3 Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) receives the ball inside the box, reacts quickly and without any problems stabs the ball low inside the left post.
86' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Heidenheim.
84' The attendance is 15000.
82' 3 - 2 Goal! Sirlord Conteh (Heidenheim) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball into the right side of the goal. It's 3:2.
80' Heidenheim take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

80' Hennes Behrens (Heidenheim) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Heidenheim.
78' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Josha Vagnoman (VfB Stuttgart) will replace Lorenz Assignon.
78' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) limps off the pitch to be replaced by Atakan Karazor.
75' Frank Schmidt prepares a substitution. Tim Siersleben is replaced by Adam Kolle (Heidenheim).
75' Niklas Dorsch (Heidenheim) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Julian Niehues.
75' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Stuttgart due to an offside in the build-up play.
75' Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.

73' The ball from the free kick finds its way to Ermedin Demirovic (VfB Stuttgart) who finds himself some space and scores with a thunderous header inside the right post. An incredible long-range header!
72' Tim Siersleben (Heidenheim) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
70' Lorenz Assignon (VfB Stuttgart) tries to find Deniz Undav, but he puts too much power on the pass.
69' A snap shot by Stefan Schimmer (Heidenheim) from the edge of the area flies towards the bottom left corner, but Alexander Nubel produces a good save to thwart him.
68' Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
66' Substitution. Bilal El Khannouss makes his way off the pitch and Nikolas Nartey (VfB Stuttgart) comes on as his replacement.
66' Here is a change. Chris Fuhrich is going off and Sebastian Hoeness gives the last tactical orders to Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart).
65' Stefan Schimmer (Heidenheim) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
65' Substitution. Marvin Pieringer walks off the pitch and Stefan Schimmer (Heidenheim) comes on as a substitute.
64' Frank Schmidt decides to make a substitution. Christian Conteh will be replaced by Sirlord Conteh (Heidenheim).
64' Marvin Pieringer (Heidenheim) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
63' Lorenz Assignon (VfB Stuttgart) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
61' The ball is cleared after Eren Dinkci (Heidenheim) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
60' Eren Dinkci (Heidenheim) latches on to a pass on the edge of the box, but he can't get any power into the shot and fails to trouble Alexander Nubel.
58' Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.

58' Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) received a pass inside the box and sent a dangerous shot in on goal, but keep the champagne on ice as one of the defenders stepped in and blocked the effort. It's hard to say whether the keeper would have stopped it. The referee signals a corner kick to Stuttgart.
56' Christian Conteh (Heidenheim) forces a pass into the box, but Alexander Nubel is alert and does a great job to rob him of the ball.
55' Bilal El Khannouss (VfB Stuttgart) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Sascha Stegemann blows his whistle for a foul.

53' Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the area, but he drags his shot just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Heidenheim.
52' Substitution. Tiago Tomas will be replaced by Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart).

50' Arijon Ibrahimovic (Heidenheim) collects a great pass inside the box and misses a golden opportunity. His low drive is headed for the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper pulls off a marvellous diving save and denies him.
50' Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) attempts to create a scoring opportunity with a wonderful long ball, but his pass is blocked.
49' A lofted cross from Omar Haktab Traore (Heidenheim) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
48' Tiago Tomas (VfB Stuttgart) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
47' Benedikt Gimber (Heidenheim) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+8' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+6' A clumsy foul by Chema Andres (VfB Stuttgart) and Sascha Stegemann blows his whistle.
45+4' Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
45' We will have 7 min. of added time.
45' 2 - 2 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart) low into the right of the net, giving goalkeeper Diant Ramaj no chance!
45' Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
44' Christian Conteh (Heidenheim) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Sascha Stegemann blows his whistle for a foul. The referee makes the call - penalty to Stuttgart!
42' Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
39' Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
37' Eren Dinkci (Heidenheim) makes a good run with the ball, but his shot from the edge of the penalty area goes just wide of the left post. Terrific solo effort, though.
34' 2 - 1 Goal! Arijon Ibrahimovic (Heidenheim) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Alexander Nubel into the bottom right corner.
34' Arijon Ibrahimovic (Heidenheim) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
34' The Heidenheim players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!
34' Celebrations are cut short for Stuttgart as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review due to a foul in the build-up play.
31' Wait! Referee Sascha Stegemann has indicated he is going to review the Stuttgart goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was a foul in the build-up.
30' Ermedin Demirovic (VfB Stuttgart) has acres of space after latching on to a precise pass into the box. He doesn't hesitate to release a low effort which ends up in the bottom right corner.
30' Eren Dinkci (Heidenheim) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
29' Stuttgart fail to score from a corner as Diant Ramaj (Heidenheim) leaps to collect the ball.

28' That was a nice football moment. Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) receives an amazing defence-splitting low pass on the edge of the box and blasts the ball towards the roof of the net. Diant Ramaj guesses his intention and dives superbly to deny him with a remarkable save! Corner kick. Stuttgart will have an opportunity.
26' Omar Haktab Traore (Heidenheim) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Sascha Stegemann has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
24' We are about to witness a subsitution. Omar Haktab Traore (Heidenheim) for Jan Schoppner.
23' A crossfield pass from Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) fails to find any of his teammates.
20' 1 - 1 Eren Dinkci (Heidenheim) gets on the scoresheet! He latched on to a precise pass and coolly slotted the ball into the top left corner.
19' Sascha Stegemann blows his whistle and it's Christian Conteh (Heidenheim) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
18' Sascha Stegemann has a clear sight and sees a foul from Marvin Pieringer (Heidenheim).
18' Ermedin Demirovic (VfB Stuttgart) is well placed to meet a cross and sends a difficult header towards the left post, but the goalkeeper reacts well to stop the effort.
15' Christian Conteh (Heidenheim) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
13' The Stuttgart players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
10' Stuttgart can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
9' Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger. The linesman makes the right call and Stuttgart will have a corner.
8' Christian Conteh (Heidenheim) is caught offside!
5' 0 - 1 Goal! It's a catastrophic error from the opponent which has gifted a chance to Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart), who rolls the ball into the back of the net from close range. 0:1.
2' Marvin Pieringer (Heidenheim) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
1' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Marvin Pieringer (Heidenheim) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
1' The first half has just begun.
Stuttgart will kick-off.
Sascha Stegemann is the one to supervise the game today.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
